entities.name: Golem
entities.description: A creature type describing artificial life-forms created by magic, usually from a specific material.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A figure inspired by Thran Golems who copied their design; he created golems animated with the word EMETH while dueling Gerrard in Phyrexia.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Dueled Urza in Phyrexia.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Creator of the Ur-Golems in his image.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Took over Mirrodin and sent the Ur-Golems to fight the mycosynth plague.

entities.name: Ur-Golems
entities.description: An ancient civilization of golems created by Karn that lived on Mirrodin, eradicated by the mycosynth plague.

entities.name: Thran Golems
entities.description: Among the most ancient forms of golems, usually powered by powerstones.

entities.name: Hollow Warriors
entities.description: Golems used by the Keldons in their invasion of Jamuraa, powered by the life force of living beings.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: Invaders of Jamuraa who used Hollow Warriors.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: The guild that created Glass Golems.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The body that used Walking Archives.

entities.name: Jeskai Way
entities.description: Monks who constructed the golems of Tarkir.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: Raiders who steal old Jeskai golems for treasure guarding in the new timeline.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire whose priests crafted stone guardians, ruled from Orazca.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: The artifact whose magic gave life to the stone guardians.

entities.name: Hammer of Purphoros
entities.description: A hammer with which Purphoros can create golems infused with Nyx.

entities.name: Colossus of Akros
entities.description: The most impressive statue golem guarding a polis.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane where the Ur-Golems lived.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane whose golems were made by pre-Eldrazi civilizations.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city from which the Sun Empire was ruled.

events.summary: Golems on Amonkhet are formed after the Hour of Devastation when the Tombs of Disgrace come to life.
events.quote: The Tombs of Disgrace, sarcophagi once used to imprison dissenters against the God-Pharaohs teachings, came to life

events.summary: Urza creates golems animated with the word EMETH while dueling Gerrard in Phyrexia.
events.quote: he created several golems that he brought to life by inscribing them with the word EMETH

events.summary: Memnarch takes over Mirrodin and sends the Ur-Golems against the mycosynth plague, which eradicates them.
events.quote: who sent them to fight the mycosynth plague that eventually eradicated them

relations.quote: created by Karn in his image
Glass Golems were created by the Izzet .

relations.note: used them in the invasion of Jamuraa
relations.quote: Hollow Warriors were used by the Keldons during their invasion of Jamuraa .
The golems of Tarkir were constructed by the monks of the Jeskai Way .
